int_name: N LEITHGOW ST & W SOMERSET ST

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban street corner with a sidewalk and a curb ramp but lacks marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. A parked vehicle near the corner creates a significant visual obstruction for anyone attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The red SUV parked close to the corner blocks the view of oncoming traffic for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There is no marked crosswalk at the intersection, making pedestrian movements less predictable for drivers.

interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the intersection to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Stop Sign Installation
interventions.description: Add a stop sign to control vehicle flow and ensure drivers stop before the pedestrian crossing area.

result.summary: The street features wide, well-maintained sidewalks with curb ramps, but lacks essential crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or traffic control devices. result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide, well-maintained sidewalk adjacent to an institutional building, likely a school. However, there is a complete lack of visible crossing infrastructure, such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps, at the intersection indicated by the street signs.

hazards.description: No painted markings are visible at the intersection to designate a safe crossing point for pedestrians.
